title: Late-Enrollment-Deposit Points — Good Faith & Price Estimates Maternity Terms
content:
**Q. Does it matter how long after enrollment the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery enrollment deposit is paid?**

Yes, under Good Faith & Price Estimates. The days since enrollment run from the scheduling date of the estimate to today's date, the scheduling date not counted and today counted. Sixty or more days since enrollment add ten percentage points (10) to the enrollment deposit percentage; thirty to fifty-nine add five (5); fewer than thirty add none, a scheduling date later than today's date counting as zero days. The points are added before the percentage is applied.

| Days since enrollment | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 10 |
| 30 to 59 | 5 |
| 0 to 29 (a scheduling date after today counts as 0) | none |

**Q. Edges?** (hypothetical) 29 days, none; 30 days, 5; 59 days, 5; 60 days, 10.
